name: Kitahara Shizuko

appearance.body: Slender as a twig, young-looking even for 17, undeveloped
appearance.hero_form: Metal pieces from attaché case attach to body forming armor/weapons

personality.demeanor: Stammering, easily flustered, conflicted about sexuality
personality.sexuality: Virgin, curious but ashamed of sexual feelings, possibly has feelings for Kirara

abilities.nanomodules: Tiny machines implanted in her body form artificial nervous system
abilities.external_terminal: Attaché case contains nanomodules that form weapons and armor
abilities.energy_beam: Can fire destructive energy from fingertips
abilities.enhanced_senses: Can switch to heat detection vision, enhanced audio pickup
abilities.direct_communication: Can receive transmissions directly in her nanomodule brain

background: Spent most of her 17 years in a lab. At age 4, an accident killed her mother and destroyed her neurons. Her father implanted nanomodules to save her. After her father died, her uncle imprisoned her as a lab rat. She escaped, destroyed the lab, and was found by Kirara who took her in. She's inexperienced with the world and sexuality.

relationships.kirara_flare: Rescued her, possibly has romantic feelings for her
relationships.rindou_rei: Teammate, sometimes spies on her and Bell

trauma: Imprisoned in lab by uncle, only recently learned about the outside world
